credits.title: Echo 8 Beyond
credits.overview: After the occurrences of 'Echo 8,' Anna finds herself pursued by lethal Zodiac operatives tasked with her termination. Living off-grid, she shields her mother from a distance. However, her identity is exposed when she crosses paths with a group of misfits.

credits.title: Hostile Forces
credits.overview: After discovering a fortune in stolen contraband, a military veteran and his family must run from a hit squad in a desperate fight for survival.

credits.title: The Combination Redemption
credits.overview: Six years on and John is still haunted by the death of his younger brother. The choices he faces will push him to the edge like never before.

credits.title: Convict
credits.overview: Set in the dark and old Parramatta prison built by the original convicts our lead character Ray a war veteran finds himself serving 18 months for manslaughter after defending his fiance. He soon realizes that the prison boss has it in for him and does everything possible to break Ray even going after his fiance.

credits.title: The Combination
credits.overview: Set in the maligned western suburbs of Sydney, Lebanese-Australian John gets out of gaol to discover his younger brother Charlie is caught up with drugs, hookers and crime.
